# awscc_networksecuritymanager_policy (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::NetworkSecurityManager::Policy



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `associated_template_and_rule_list` (Attributes List) List of templates and rules associated with this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--associated_template_and_rule_list))
- `firewall_type` (String) The type of firewall.
- `policy_arn` (String) The ARN of the policy.
- `policy_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration settings for policy behavior. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_configuration))
- `policy_description` (String) A description of the policy.
- `policy_id` (String) The unique identifier of the policy.
- `policy_name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the policy.
- `status` (String) The status of the policy.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags associated with the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the policy was last modified.
- `version` (String) The version number.

<a id="nestedatt--associated_template_and_rule_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `associated_template_and_rule_list`

Read-Only:

- `rule_arn` (String) ARN of the associated rule.
- `template_arn` (String) ARN of the associated template.


<a id="nestedatt--policy_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `remediation_enabled` (Boolean) Controls automatic remediation of non-compliant resources.
- `resources_clean_up` (Boolean) Controls automatic cleanup of unused resources.
- `waf_config` (Attributes) WAF-specific policy settings. Populated only for WAF firewall type policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_configuration--waf_config))

<a id="nestedatt--policy_configuration--waf_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_configuration.waf_config`

Read-Only:

- `conflict_resolution` (String) Conflict-resolution strategy applied to AWS WAF policies.
- `existing_customer_web_acl_resolution` (String) Controls how Network Security Manager handles remediation when a resource already has a customer-created WebACL.
